newsitem.title: USA: Dow jumps 1.7 pct to record high close.
newsitem.headline: Dow jumps 1.7 pct to record high close.

text.p: A broad rally on Wall Street on Monday drove U.S. blue chips to a record closing high.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average ended up unofficially 123.63 points, or 1.7 percent, to 7293.16. The move eclipsed the record close set last Tuesday at 7225.32.
The Standard & Poor's 500 index also reached record territory, rising unofficially 12.94, or 1.6 percent, to 837.72. It beat its record set last Monday at 830.29.
The Nasdaq composite rose 9.13 to 1344.18, still below its January 22 high of 1388.06.
